name: init-it
description: DevOtts marketplace for Claude Code plugins. Add this repo, then install init-it (register a session against an implementation). Its own marketplace name, so it can be added next to the devotts hub (do-it) without a clash.

plugins.name: init-it
plugins.description: Register this session against docs/implementations/<name>: status.json sessions[] entry (via build-it status-write), open ledger card, INDEX row. Deterministic, idempotent, no network.
